content.en: Inflation is measured by tracking the change in the price of a **representative basket of goods and services**. In India, the two primary measures are the **Wholesale Price Index (WPI)** and the **Consumer Price Index (CPI)**. The WPI tracks price changes at the wholesale level, while the CPI measures price changes from the perspective of the retail consumer.
